# sherpa-node-frame

A FRAME on a [sherpa-layout-canvas](sherpa-layout-canvas.md): nodes under one header, with a title, a line and Release. Its host draws it ROUND its nodes: data-x, data-y, data-w and data-h are their box, and the frame stands clear of it, its header above. It sits behind every line and node, and only its header takes the pointer. Will, TODO 778. TRAP T-a-frame-is-drawn-round-its-nodes

## When to use it

For nodes on a `sherpa-layout-canvas` that belong together: a frame round them, behind them, with a title, a line and a Release button in its header. Its host writes the box round its nodes (`data-x`, `data-y`, `data-w`, `data-h`) and `data-current` on the one it picks; a drag on the header, or an arrow key there, reports `frame-move` with the step, and the host moves every node in it. Release, or Delete on the header, reports `frame-release`. For one step of a flow, use `sherpa-node`.

## Example

```html
<sherpa-layout-canvas style="inline-size: 720px; block-size: 420px"><sherpa-node-frame data-heading="Active customers" data-description="Who signed in this month" data-x="80" data-y="104" data-w="240" data-h="232" data-current></sherpa-node-frame><sherpa-node data-heading="Store" data-icon="store" data-x="80" data-y="104" data-output-socket="object" data-output-routed></sherpa-node><sherpa-node data-heading="Condition" data-icon="function" data-x="80" data-y="260" data-input-socket="any" data-input-routed data-branches></sherpa-node></sherpa-layout-canvas>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-current` | boolean |  | the frame picked, in the look of a picked node; the HOST writes it |
| `data-description` | text |  | its line, under the title |
| `data-h` | number | `0` | that box's height, in plane px |
| `data-heading` | text | `Frame` | its title, in its header (default Frame) |
| `data-locked` | boolean |  | the host is read only: no Release button, no grab cursor. A drag or a key still reports |
| `data-w` | number | `0` | that box's width, in plane px |
| `data-x` | number | `0` | the left of the box round its nodes, in plane px |
| `data-y` | number | `0` | the top of that box, in plane px |

## Events

Each one bubbles.

| Event | Detail | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| `frame-move` | `{ dx: number; dy: number }` | Its header was dragged, or an arrow key pressed there: its host moves every node in it. |
| `frame-select` |  | It was pressed: a click on its header, or Enter or Space there. |
| `frame-release` |  | Release was pressed, or Delete or Backspace on its header: its host takes the frame away, and its nodes stay. |

## Parts

Style these from outside with `::part()`:

`frame`, `header`, `heading`, `release`
